basic_details.job_title: TSU Senior Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tribhuvan" Sahkari University (TSU) is recruiting candidates for 3 Senior Officer (Academics) vacancies on a contract basis for three years. Eligible applicants must possess a Master's Degree or equivalent in any discipline along with three years' experience in a supervisory or mid-level management role. The consolidated pay is Rs. 88,000 Per Month. Candidates can apply online through the University website on or before 22 November 2026 at 23:59 hrs, as only online applications are accepted. The selection process includes a Screening Test for shortlisting, an Interview, and Document Verificati

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years as on the prescribed closing date for submission of the online application. Age Relaxation: Upper age limit relaxed for SC/ST/OBC/Disabled/Ex-servicemen as per GoI Rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree or equivalent in any discipline from any recognised University/Institute, with three years' experience in a supervisory/mid-level management role, plus digital office, drafting and communication skills.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by "Tribhuvan" Sahkari University (TSU) located in Anand, Gujarat, for filling up academic positions across its campuses.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by TSU?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Senior Officer (Academics) under the academic department on a contract basis for a period of three years.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Senior Officer (Academics) position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree or equivalent in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute along with relevant supervisory or mid-level management experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required work experience for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must have at least three years of experience in a supervisory or mid-level management role in government, autonomous bodies, higher educational institutions, PSUs, or reputed private organizations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit to apply for the post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates is 35 years as on the prescribed closing date, with relaxations applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the consolidated salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 88,000/- per month throughout their contractual employment period.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications is 22 November 2026 up to 23:59 hours through the official university website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for TSU Senior Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Screening Test for shortlisting candidates, followed by a personal Interview and final Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online directly by visiting the official university careers portal at https://tsu.ac.in/careers/careers.php.
